The '''Grand Magnus''' was the title of an official from the celestial body [[Xerton Nine]].<ref name="Blasters">{{JournalCite|3|Blasters for Hire}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title of the Grand Magnus was mentioned in "[[Blasters for Hire]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tony Russo|Anthony P. Russo]] and published in the [[August]] [[1994]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Blasters" />
